execution.providerAdapter: phase1-core-loop fake agent-tool executor and mock GitHub fetch

journeys.description: Persist onboarding step, dismiss, reload and resume; account evidence stays server owned.
Create an employee profile, persist and launch its thread, and prove its selected profile version/provider are frozen at the approval boundary.
Queue a task through the real orchestrator request handler, prove the deterministic harness stays idle before approval, then approve the frozen input and verify its completed diff/result.
Persist scoped tool-invocation receipts and approval pointers without storing arguments or result bodies; replay and terminal transitions are covered.
Approve artifact-workspace input, verify requested files, store bytes in the deterministic R2 adapter, and exercise the authenticated download route.
Create and reload a room, persist messages, enforce membership, create bounded handoffs and cancel a lineage.
Create and reload a versioned skill draft, preserve immutable versions, review/activate exact text, and exercise the dashboard editor recovery paths.
Exercise deterministic harness failure, review retry, run cancellation fencing, command replay, and durable-state restart behavior where implemented.

journeys.blocker: Not executed: this acceptance suite deliberately uses a deterministic local harness adapter; the delegated scope prohibits credential setup and paid/live provider execution, and a synthetic executor is not evidence that a live Sandbox or model provider works.
Not claimed: included dashboard tests mount React components with deterministic fetch fixtures; this suite does not run a real browser against a local Worker and Durable Object session.
